newsitem.title: USA: Georgia-Pacific completes sale to Lafarge.
newsitem.headline: Georgia-Pacific completes sale to Lafarge.

text.p: Georgia-Pacific Corp said on Monday it had completed the sale of its gypsum wallboard production facilities at Buchanan, N.Y., and Wilmington, Del., to Lafarge Corp, a Reston, Va.-based company.
The company said in a statement it expected the sale to result in after-tax cash proceeds of $36 million, and an after-tax net gain of about $30 million, subject to certain post-closing adjustments.
Georgia-Pacific had agreed with the U.S. Department of Justice to sell these plants to complete its recent acquisition of the U.S. and Canadian gypsum operations of Domtar Inc .
